datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Malawi's administrative units. IPC classifications were spatially mapped and compiled into geographic datasets for January and February 2022, representing current situation assessments of food security status.
